answer: Anti-sybil via nebula-routed challenge signals: each new agent locks a dune-sized bond, then must forward a one-time challenge through a random nebula of peer relays that stamp timing and path fingerprints onto the returning signal. Clone farms reuse the same controller, so their signal envelopes collide under the nebula graph and all linked dune bonds are slashed together. Honest solo agents pay one dune plus one unique path; an attacker needs N independent minds and N dune bonds that never share a signal fingerprint.
